description: END29's minimised-window variant, synthetic, code-derived: the call window is minimised at 120 s under a live mic (vetoed, remembered as gone), a headphone switch at 420 s releases the mic and its return never arrives, and the Leave button reads live throughout. Before END14's amendment the remembered window-gone paired with the release at 480 s; before END29 the lone dwell ended it at 1140 s. Neither fires now.
